rates.quote: (ii) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases;

However, such interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 percent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 percent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Agreement.

notes: Dividend limits are asymmetric: Art. 10(2)(a) caps Armenian tax on dividends paid by Armenian companies (5% tier also requires investment of at least EUR 1.5 million in share capital at payment date); Art. 10(2)(b): for dividends paid by a Maltese company 'Malta tax on the gross amount of the dividends shall not exceed that chargeable on the profits out of which the dividends are paid' (no fixed percentage; MT-source dividends not modelled). No interest exemptions in Art. 11. Art. 28: in Armenia WHT on income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2021-11-25 -> 2022-01-01); in Malta for calendar years/accounting periods beginning on or after 1 January immediately following EIF. Not MLI-covered (signed after Malta's MLI deposit); PPT in treaty Art. 27. [curated: dropped DIVIDEND tier — reduced rate also needs a minimum invested amount — not modelled]
